instruments: NQ traded for every hypothesis except H22 (ES traded, NQ leads); ES/NQ as the other market

catalog.title: Efficient momentum
catalog.rule: Z(n) crosses +/-z; confluence: normalised path efficiency PE(n)*sqrt(n) >= pe.

catalog.title: Momentum acceleration
catalog.rule: Recent k-bar impulse Z(k) >= zk; confluence acc: the preceding m-bar move agrees in direction (acc=0) and recent per-minute speed >= acc x prior per-minute speed.

catalog.title: Multi-horizon momentum
catalog.rule: Directional agreement of Z(5), Z(30), Z(120) (each >= z) for the selected horizons.

catalog.title: HTF trend + short-term impulse
catalog.rule: HTF state Z(htf) >= zh (2h or 4h) and/or a k-minute impulse Z(k) >= zi, same direction.

catalog.title: Volatility-shock momentum
catalog.rule: Z(n) >= z during a realised-vol shock rv15 / same-time-of-day baseline >= v.

catalog.title: Compression to expansion
catalog.rule: Close breaks the previous N-bar high/low; confluence: the N bars before were compressed (rv_N / time-of-day norm <= cth); optional strength Z(5) >= 1.

catalog.title: Opening-drive continuation
catalog.rule: At 09:30+w: RTH move >= m x D; confluence: efficiency since the open >= e.

catalog.title: Morning trend continuation
catalog.rule: At cutoff (10:30/11:00): return from the open >= m x D; confluences: efficiency >= e, closing location in the range >= cl (in the trend direction).

catalog.title: Last-hour trend continuation
catalog.rule: At 15:00: session return from the open >= m x D; confluences: efficiency, closing location.

catalog.title: Impulse + pullback continuation
catalog.rule: Impulse Z(L) >= zi, then a controlled pullback of >= retr of the impulse (cancelled beyond 75% or after 60 bars), then resumption: close beyond the previous bar's extreme. retr None = enter at the impulse (parent).

catalog.title: Failed countertrend move
catalog.rule: Trend: Z(120) measured before the counter move >= zt; counter move: 10-minute Z <= -zc; resumption within 30 bars: close above the previous r-bar high. zc None = resumption trigger in trend without a counter move (parent).

catalog.title: Breakout + acceptance
catalog.rule: Level: previous 120-bar high/low, overnight high/low, previous-day RTH high/low. Acceptance: first close beyond (parent), 2nd / 3rd consecutive close, retest, displacement.

catalog.title: Rolling-mean overextension
catalog.rule: dev(n) = (close - mean of previous n closes)/(sigma_tod(n)*sqrt(n)) >= d; fade. Natural target: the mean.

catalog.title: Deceleration exhaustion
catalog.rule: Extended move Z(N) >= z and a new N-bar high, while the last-5-bar per-minute speed <= r x the per-minute speed of the earlier part of the move. r None = no deceleration (parent).

catalog.title: Session-extreme rejection
catalog.rule: After 10:00, a new RTH session high then, within k bars of the latest new high, a close <= extreme - rj x ATRh and below the high it broke. Fade.

catalog.title: PDH/PDL failed break
catalog.rule: Failed break of the previous day's RTH high/low; fade back into the range. Natural target: prior-range mid.

catalog.title: Overnight-extreme failed break
catalog.rule: Failed break of the overnight high/low during RTH; fade. Natural target: overnight-range mid.

catalog.title: Opening-range failed breakout
catalog.rule: Failed break of the w-minute opening range; fade. Natural target: opening-range mid.

catalog.title: Large morning move reversal
catalog.rule: RTH high - open >= m x D, then (10:00-13:00) a retracement from the high of >= dr of that move (deterioration). dr None = fade at 11:00 without deterioration (parent). Natural target: RTH open.

catalog.title: Extreme-move path test
catalog.rule: Equally large moves Z(n) >= z split by path efficiency: HIGH (PE >= pe_hi) or LOW (PE <= pe_lo); each tested as continuation AND reversal.

catalog.title: ES leads NQ
catalog.rule: The OTHER market's w-minute move >= zE sigma units; confluence lag: this market's move is <= 0.5x the other's (has not yet responded). Trades this market in the other's direction.

catalog.title: NQ leads ES
catalog.rule: The OTHER market's w-minute move >= zE sigma units; confluence lag: this market's move is <= 0.5x the other's (has not yet responded). Trades this market in the other's direction. (Traded on ES with NQ as the leader.)

catalog.title: Relative momentum
catalog.rule: Z_NQ(n) - Z_ES(n) >= thr (NQ outperforming, vol-adjusted): trade NQ in that direction.

catalog.title: Beta-adjusted NQ/ES residual reversion
catalog.rule: Residual of NQ's W-minute log return vs beta x ES's (beta from the 390 one-minute returns ending W bars earlier), standardised; |z| >= thr: fade. Natural target: residual = 0 with ES unchanged.

catalog.title: Correlation breakdown
catalog.rule: 30-minute NQ/ES return correlation <= cth and |30-minute beta residual z| >= rz. Separate hypotheses: continuation (follow NQ's residual) and convergence (fade it).

catalog.title: Mechanical SMT / non-confirmation
catalog.rule: One market makes a new extreme (previous N-bar or RTH session high/low) that the other does not. kind nq_only: this market swept, other did not; es_only: the other swept, this did not. Confirmation 'rej': within 10 bars this market closes beyond its previous 3-bar extreme against the sweep. Fade.

catalog.title: Cross-market momentum confirmation
catalog.rule: NQ Z(n) >= z; confluence: ES Z(n) >= ce in the same direction.

catalog.title: Cross-market disagreement reversal
catalog.rule: NQ 30-minute Z >= z; confluence es: ES 30-minute Z <= 0.5z (not confirming); confluence trig: within 15 bars NQ closes beyond its previous 3-bar extreme against the move. Fade.

catalog.title: Relative acceleration
catalog.rule: Relative move rel_k = Z_NQ(k) - Z_ES(k) >= thr; confluence acc: rel_k/sqrt(k) >= acc x the relative move over the preceding 20 bars / sqrt(20). Trades NQ absolute continuation.

catalog.title: Path-efficiency continuation
catalog.rule: Normalised path efficiency PE(n)*sqrt(n) >= e with at least a modest move Z(n) >= 0.75; continuation.

catalog.title: Low-efficiency reversal
catalog.rule: Large move Z(n) >= z achieved with normalised path efficiency PE(n)*sqrt(n) <= e (noisy path); fade.

catalog.title: Speed shock
catalog.rule: |k-minute move| >= s x its same-time-of-day mean |k-minute move|; direction = sign of the move; continuation and reversal tested separately.

catalog.title: Acceleration (three windows)
catalog.rule: Three consecutive w-minute moves in the same direction with strictly increasing size, total move Z(3w) >= z; continuation.

catalog.title: Deceleration
catalog.rule: Three consecutive w-minute moves in the same direction with strictly decreasing size (still progressing), total Z(3w) >= z; fade.

catalog.title: Pullback quality
catalog.rule: As H10 (30-minute impulse, 33% pullback, resumption) with the pullback classified FAST (depth reached <= 5 bars after the extreme) or SLOW (>= 15 bars). qual None = any (parent).

catalog.title: Time since session high/low
catalog.rule: stale: the RTH high was set >= Tm minutes ago and the close is still in the top 20% of the RTH range (failed to extend). fresh: a new RTH high after >= Tm minutes without one. Each tested as continuation and reversal (mirror for lows). After 10:30.

catalog.title: Realised-volatility shock
catalog.rule: rv15 / same-time-of-day norm >= v (onset); confluence hist: rv15 / rv390 >= 1.5 (also high vs recent history). Direction = sign of the 15-minute move. Continuation and reversal.

catalog.title: Volatility-of-volatility shock
catalog.rule: rv15 now / rv15 of the previous 15 bars >= q (jump) or <= 1/q (collapse); direction = sign of the 15-minute move; continuation and reversal.

catalog.title: Intraday compression breakout
catalog.rule: A 5-minute move Z(5) >= z5 (volatility expansion); confluence: the 30 bars before were compressed (rv30 / time-of-day norm, measured at t-1, <= cth). Trade the expansion direction.

catalog.title: Daily compression -> intraday expansion
catalog.rule: Confluence dc: mean RTH range of the previous 3 sessions <= dc x that of the previous 20. Trigger: first close of the session beyond the 30-minute opening range (or2) or beyond the previous-day RTH high/low (pd). Continuation.

catalog.title: Variance-ratio trending regime + momentum
catalog.rule: Momentum Z(15) >= z; confluence: variance ratio VR(5) over the last L bars >= vr (persistent).

catalog.title: Variance-ratio mean-reverting regime + reversion
catalog.rule: Overextension dev(30) >= d; confluence: VR(5) over the last L bars <= vr (anti-persistent). Fade; natural target: the mean.

catalog.title: Positive autocorrelation regime + momentum
catalog.rule: Momentum Z(15) >= z; confluence: lag-1 autocorrelation of the last 24 five-minute returns >= a.

catalog.title: Negative autocorrelation regime + mean reversion
catalog.rule: Overextension dev(30) >= d; confluence: 5-minute return autocorrelation (last 24) <= -a. Fade; natural target: the mean.

catalog.title: Early trend-day classification
catalog.rule: At the cutoff count five transparent criteria: |return from open| >= 0.2D, RTH range >= 0.45D, efficiency >= 0.2, close location in the direction >= 0.75, 30-minute realised vol >= its time-of-day norm. Trend day if >= k are met; trade the open-to-cutoff direction.

catalog.title: Early range-day classification + fade
catalog.rule: At the cutoff count three criteria: efficiency since open <= 0.1, >= 4 crossings of the RTH open, |return| <= 0.12D. Range day if >= strict are met (None = no classification, parent). Then until 15:00 fade the first bar that trades beyond the cutoff's RTH high (low) and closes back inside. Natural target: mid of the cutoff range.

catalog.title: Large overnight move + same-direction open
catalog.rule: Gap (RTH open - previous RTH close) >= g x D; confluence open: at 09:30+w the close is >= 0.05D beyond the RTH open in the gap direction. Continuation, entered at 09:30+w.

catalog.title: Large overnight move + opening rejection
catalog.rule: Gap >= g x D, then at 09:30+w the close is >= o x D back against the gap from the RTH open. Fade the gap. Natural target: the previous RTH close (gap fill).

catalog.title: Morning range -> afternoon continuation / reversal
catalog.rule: At 12:00 the morning RTH range >= r x D; kind eff: efficiency since the open >= 0.13; ineff: <= 0.035 (discovery quartiles). Direction = sign of the morning move. Each kind as continuation and reversal.

catalog.title: Trend morning -> lunch consolidation -> PM continuation
catalog.rule: A: at 11:30 the close is >= m x D from the RTH open with efficiency >= 0.1. B (cons): the 11:30-13:30 range <= cons x the 09:30-11:30 range. C (trig=brk): after 13:30 the first close beyond the 11:30-13:30 range in the morning direction; trig None: enter at 13:30.

catalog.title: Turn-of-month long
catalog.rule: Executor hypothesis X1: month-start institutional inflows. On the first N sessions of a calendar month, buy at 09:31 (signal at the 09:30 bar's close). Long only.

catalog.title: First half-hour predicts last half-hour
catalog.rule: Executor hypothesis X2 (intraday time-series momentum; late-day hedging/rebalancing flow): the return to 10:00 (from the previous RTH close, base=pcl, or from the RTH open, base=open) >= thr x D sets the direction; enter at 15:30, exit by 16:00. thr 0 = sign only.

catalog.title: Correlation-regime momentum
catalog.rule: Executor hypothesis X3: momentum Z(30) >= z is market-wide (and should persist) when NQ/ES one-minute correlation over the last 390 bars is high (>= 0.9), idiosyncratic when low (<= 0.75).

X1.hypothesis: Month-start institutional inflows (pension / payroll contributions) lift equity-index futures during the first sessions of a calendar month.
X1.rule: On the first N RTH sessions of a calendar month (sessions counted by session end date), buy at 09:31 (signal = close of the 09:30 bar); long only; exits per the management library.
X1.mechanism: calendar-driven flow; not a price-pattern; independent of every H01-H50 signal

X2.hypothesis: Intraday time-series momentum: the return to 10:00 predicts the last half hour (late-day hedging / rebalancing flows that trade with the day's direction).
X2.rule: At 15:30 enter in the direction of the 10:00 close relative to the previous RTH close (base=pcl) or the RTH open (base=open) when |return| > thr x D; flat by 16:00.
X2.mechanism: documented intraday momentum (first half-hour -> last half-hour); differs from H09, which classifies the whole session at 15:00

X3.hypothesis: Momentum persists when the move is market-wide (high NQ/ES correlation) and fades when it is idiosyncratic (low correlation).
X3.rule: 30-minute momentum Z(30) >= z, optionally only when the 390-bar NQ/ES one-minute return correlation is >= 0.9 (high) or <= 0.75 (low).
X3.mechanism: breadth of participation: index-wide flow vs. sector rotation

normalisation.Z(n): (c[t]-c[t-n]) / (sigma_tod(n) * sqrt(n)); sigma_tod(n) = mean over the previous 20 sessions of rv(n) at the same session minute; rv(n) = RMS one-minute close change over n bars
normalisation.PE(n): |c[t]-c[t-n]| / sum |1-min close changes|; thresholds applied to PE(n)*sqrt(n)
normalisation.D: mean RTH range of the previous 10 completed sessions

management.stageA_continuation: ATR1 x {1R,1.5R,2R,3R,4R, no target->EOD, 60-min time exit}; ATR1.5 and STRUCT x {1R,2R,EOD}
management.stageA_reversal: ATR1 x {0.5R,0.75R,1R,1.5R,2R,3R,EOD,60-min, NATURAL if defined}; ATR1.5 and STRUCT x {0.75R,1.5R,NATURAL or EOD}
management.stageB: ATR1 only: BE {0.5,1,1.5}R x {2R | none} (continuation) or x {1.5R | 3R} (reversal); ATR trails {1.5,2,3}; confirmed-swing trail; partials 50%@1R+2R, 50%@1R+3R, 50%@1R+2ATR trail, 25%@1R+runner, (reversal) 50%@0.5R+1.5R; 50%@1R->BE->3R; BE@1R+2ATR trail
management.stageB_qualification: an entry qualifies if ANY Stage-A management variant has BASELINE net > 0
management.controls: Stage-A single-exit variants (no BE / no partial / no trail) are the controls of Stage B

execution.entry: market order at the open of the next bar (same session and contract)
execution.time_exit: scheduled; fills at the close of the last bar of the holding period
execution.stop: stop order; gap through the stop fills at the bar open; stops rounded away from entry to the tick
execution.target: limit order; fills at the target price (never better) only when the bar trades at least target_trade_through_ticks beyond it; a touch is not a fill; targets rounded away from entry
execution.same_bar_stop_and_target: resolved by ambiguity policy (baseline: stop first)
execution.breakeven: stop moves to entry intrabar when the trigger is reached; same-bar return to entry is resolved by the ambiguity policy (baseline: stopped at breakeven)
execution.trailing: recomputed at each bar close, applies from the next bar, only tightens
execution.partials: fractions of one contract; costs per round trip unchanged in one-contract terms
execution.session_end: flat at the close of the last bar before the window's flat time
execution.position: one position at a time, no pyramiding
execution.struct_stop: continuation: 1 tick beyond the last confirmed 5-minute swing; reversal: 1 tick beyond the last 15 one-minute bars' extreme; distance clipped to [0.5, 3.0] ATRh
execution.natural_target: absolute level defined by the family at the signal bar; no trade if the level is not beyond the entry price
execution.swing_trail: stop moves to 1 tick beyond the latest confirmed 5-minute swing at each bar close, effective next bar, only tightens

discovery_labels.PRIMARY: trades >= 30, BASELINE net > 0 and per-trade t-statistic >= 1.0 (mean net trade at least one standard error above zero). The only candidates ELIGIBLE for the final cohort.
discovery_labels.WEAK_POSITIVE: trades >= 30, BASELINE net > 0, t < 1.0. Frozen and tracked (diagnostic).
discovery_labels.LOW_SAMPLE: 0 < trades < 30 and BASELINE net > 0. Frozen and tracked (diagnostic).
discovery_labels.MODERATE_ONLY: MODERATE net > 0 but BASELINE net <= 0 (cost-sensitive). Frozen and tracked (diagnostic).
discovery_labels.GROSS_ONLY: GROSS > 0 but MODERATE net <= 0. Recorded in results only.
discovery_labels.flag REGIME_CONDITIONAL: PRIMARY with >= 1 confluence condition present while its parent without that condition (all else equal) has BASELINE net <= 0.

discovery_freeze_candidate_set: PRIMARY + WEAK_POSITIVE + LOW_SAMPLE + MODERATE_ONLY (every such spec is run unchanged in confirmation; only PRIMARY is eligible for the final cohort)

robustness.parameter: share of grid neighbours (same family, instrument, direction, management and every non-numeric / None-status parameter; one step apart in exactly one numeric parameter) with BASELINE net > 0
robustness.management: share of the entry's Stage-A management variants with BASELINE net > 0

ablation: for every spec with a confluence condition present, compare with the identical spec where that one condition is None: trades removed (n, %), change in PF, WR, avg net trade, expectancy (R), max DD, cost sensitivity (stress/baseline), parameter robustness, and sub-period repetition (sign of the avg-trade improvement in 2010-12, 2013-15, 2016-18)
no_further_families: no strategy family may be added after discovery results exist
